Subject: SOC2 Type II + service-account rotation artifacts request

Hi Ava,

Hope you’re well. We’re in the final stages of Meditech’s internal SOC readiness review and need to gather Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II report for the period Jan 1, 2026 — Mar 31, 2027, plus a few supporting artifacts focused on privileged/service accounts. Specifically we’d like:

- Signed SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and any separate bridge letter covering the period Apr 1, 2027 — Jun 30, 2027 (if available).
- A CSV export or equivalent of service-account key rotation events covering Jul 1, 2026 — Mar 31, 2027 (timestamps, principal, key id, rotation action).
- Evidence of privileged delegation reviews / access recertification for accounts with admin role (summary export or redacted screenshots acceptable).
- Confirmation of MFA requirement for console and service-to-service flows (we understand some S2S keys may be managed via KMS; an architecture note is helpful).

Do you have a timeline for providing those items? We may need a signed bridge letter if the SOC period doesn’t cover our audit window. If there are scope constraints or redaction requirements, please flag early so we can note them with our audit team.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Senior Security Manager, Meditech Health
security@meditech.com

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list and timelines. We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report for Jan 1, 2026 — Mar 31, 2027 and assemble the supplemental artifacts you asked for. Quick notes / asks from our side:

- We’ll prepare a CSV of rotation events (Jul 1, 2026 — Mar 31, 2027). Karthik will scope which events meet your definition of "rotation" (key rotate, key revoke+issue, and automated rotation jobs).

- MFA confirmation: we’ll provide an architecture snippet showing when MFA is enforced and how service keys are constrained by KMS/HSM policies.
- Bridge letter: we can draft a bridge letter. Would Meditech prefer Redwood to sign a PDF (and provide DocuSign link) or a self-attestation with our security contact?

Target delivery for the bundle: May 3 EOD (PST). If Meditech needs anything sooner, please let us know which piece is highest priority. I’ll loop Karthik and Logan to start the artifact pull.

Regards,

Hi team — quick technical update on the rotation/export side: we store key/rotation events in two places depending on the surface:

1) KMS audit logs (GCP/Cloud HSM) for customer-managed keys — contains key version create/revoke with timestamps and principal.
2) Internal rotation service audit table (Postgres) for Redwood-managed service accounts and automated rotation jobs — includes job id, key id, rotated_by, and sha256 fingerprint.

I can extract a CSV that maps to your requested columns (timestamp, principal, key_id, action, rotation_job_id). We’ll need to redact any raw key material (we’ll only include identifiers and fingerprints). For the access recert exports: the access system exports user/principal -> roles -> last_review_date which we can redact to user ids unless Meditech prefers full names.

Couple of constraints to call out:
- For tenant-isolated keys (customer-managed), we can provide the KMS audit slice but may need cloud-ops cooperation (we’ll include a note on SRE runbook).
- If you need a signed bridge letter, legal prefers a standard template; I’ll attach a draft for review.

I’ll start the extracts today and aim to drop the CSVs into the shared Drive by EOD May 3. If we can narrow whether you want names or anonymized ids for the access recert, we’ll tailor the export now.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Staff Engineer, Security
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: rotation-extract-query.txt]

Ava / Karthik — thanks for the quick responses. A few clarifications from our audit team: 

- We do need a signed bridge letter (PDF) that explicitly covers the gap window Apr 1, 2027 — Jun 30, 2027 if Redwood does not have another Type II report covering that time. DocuSign is preferred for chain-of-custody.
- For the rotation CSV, anonymized internal ids are fine for Redwood staff, but we need full principals for entries that involve Meditech-owned keys (i.e., we need to see when Meditech principals performed actions).
- Access recert exports should include principal email, role, and last_review_date; redaction for internal-only PII is acceptable but keep the principal identifier.

If you can send the DocuSign link for the bridge letter draft, we’ll route to our legal and get it signed quickly. Otherwise the rest of the artifacts (CSV + access export + architecture snippet) are the higher priority.

Appreciate it — Olivia
